This template is to be used for citing individual entries from the ''[[Find the Force]]'' augmented reality event.

==Usage==
Copy the template code below, paste it into the appropriate place in an article and fill in the required fields.

<code><nowiki>{{FindtheForce|text=|filename=}}</nowiki></code>

===Required parameters===
*'''text''': Name of the entry being cited.
*'''filename''': Filename of the entry's screenshot, minus the <code>File:</code> prefix.

===Examples===
<code><nowiki>{{FindtheForce|text=2BB-2|filename=Find the Force 2BB-2.png}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{FindtheForce|text=2BB-2|filename=Find the Force 2BB-2.png}}
